title: Central limit theory for serial tail dependence estimators in heavy-tailed long memory linear time series
summary: We prove multiple central limit theorems for serial tail dependence estimators in heavy-tailed long memory linear time series. The main theoretical tools are two novel multivariate reduction principles for partial sums of heavy-tailed long memory linear time series, subordinated over sliding windows and above a threshold growing with sample size.
